low.title: Full-Day Prague Art Walk on a Budget
low.summary: An affordable art-focused day exploring Prague’s rich architecture, street art, and creative neighborhoods.

schedule.title: Old Town Architectural Walk
schedule.description: Admire Gothic, Baroque, and Art Nouveau facades across Old Town Square.

schedule.title: Municipal House (Obecní dům)
schedule.description: See one of Prague’s best Art Nouveau buildings — exterior and public spaces.

schedule.title: Budget Lunch – Havelská Koruna
schedule.description: Affordable self-service Czech dishes near Wenceslas Square.

schedule.title: Lennon Wall
schedule.description: Colorful graffiti and peace messages — a constantly changing public art landmark.

schedule.title: Kampa Island Sculptures
schedule.description: Explore open-air art by David Černý and others in the riverside park.

schedule.title: Golden Hour at Charles Bridge
schedule.description: End your art walk among the statues of Prague’s most iconic bridge.

medium.title: Balanced Full-Day Art Experience
medium.summary: A relaxed but complete day for art lovers — mixing architecture, galleries, and cozy cafés.

schedule.title: National Gallery – Trade Fair Palace
schedule.description: Large modern art collection featuring Czech and European artists.

schedule.title: Lunch at Café Jedna
schedule.description: Minimalist art café inside the National Gallery — light meals and good coffee.

schedule.title: Museum Kampa
schedule.description: Modern Central European art with river views and outdoor sculptures.

schedule.title: Café Louvre
schedule.description: Historic café once visited by Kafka and Einstein — perfect art ambiance.

schedule.title: Vltava Riverside Art Walk
schedule.description: Finish your day with a sunset stroll by riverside sculptures and galleries.

high.title: High-End Prague Art Day
high.summary: A refined day through Prague’s best museums, modern art spaces, and elegant cafés.

schedule.title: National Gallery – Convent of St. Agnes
schedule.description: Czech medieval and early Renaissance art in a tranquil monastic setting.

schedule.title: Lunch at Mlynec
schedule.description: Elegant restaurant overlooking Charles Bridge, offering artful Czech dishes.

schedule.title: DOX Centre for Contemporary Art
schedule.description: Innovative exhibitions and large installations in an industrial-style space.

schedule.title: Premium Café Stop – EMA Espresso Bar
schedule.description: Minimalist café loved by artists and locals for its design and coffee.

comfortable.title: Luxury Art Journey Through Prague
comfortable.summary: Private tours, gallery visits, fine dining, and the city’s most beautiful architecture in one immersive day.

schedule.title: Private Art Tour – National Gallery Highlights
schedule.description: Exclusive guided visit through Czech masterpieces with a professional art historian.

schedule.title: Lunch at Bellevue Restaurant
schedule.description: Elegant fine-dining restaurant with artistic presentation and river views.

schedule.title: Private Visit – Strahov Monastery Library
schedule.description: Guided access to historic halls filled with art, books, and frescoes.

schedule.title: Sunset at Letná Park Sculpture Garden
schedule.description: End your day among sculptures and panoramic views of the city.
